episodes.title: Grávida do Bilionário - T1E1
episodes.desc: Mia Harper, down on her luck, marries wealthy CEO Carter Prescott as part of a deal. Their fake marriage soon blossoms into real romance, but their love is tested when Carter's ruthless ex, Lily, stops at nothing to win him back. The drama intensifies when Mia discovers she's pregnant with Carter's baby and uncovers the shocking truth that Lily is her long-lost stepsister...
